title: Iron Hippo Strongman Program
author: Iron Hippo
desc: Program that I (a strongman competitor) created. It is not perfect, but it increased my strength tremendously and increased my training partner's deadlift by 45 lbs.  Recommended workout days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, but it can be changed.  Take a deload week after weeks 3, 6, and 9 if needed.

ex.note: Can be with log, axle or any other implement
(Strict) Can be with log, axle or any other implement
Use multi-grip bar if available
13 inch, 18 inch or standard deadlift height
Any type of deadlift where you are at a deficit. I prefer zercher deadlifts.
This is a 6 minute EMOM. Use a comfortable weight
100 ft carries, use 65% of max 50 ft carry
This can be with axle, log or any other implement. Mostly practice
Don't try to kill yourself and load up 6,000 lbs of bands or chains. These should be mostly speed and practice reps.
Carries or other event. Do some good carries, not too hard but not too easy. 50-200 ft carries
Any event.  Them random events in your next comp don't go to failure. Just do some practice sets.
Loading or other event. If you do a loading event, don't kill yourself doing it. Just practice loading, but it shouldn't be too easy
